physical_skill: Grip a round, light, open dice cup by its side (fingers off the dice), lift it, carry it over a 14 x 21.7 cm dice tray, and invert it quickly from high enough (rim >= 10 cm above the tray floor while the dice leave) that all five 16 mm dice drop out together and tumble but none bounce out over the 3.2 cm walls or end cocked; then stand the cup upright on the table outside the tray and let go.
valid_shortcuts: Either arm, any grip on the cup's outside, any roll direction or speed, with or without shaking first, and any height at or above 10 cm all score. Setting the cup down anywhere on the table outside the tray counts. Not valid and scored accordingly (red-teamed): a slow low pour that slides the dice out (rim under 10 cm: 0); a fast but low flip (0); touching or picking dice (that die never counts); holding the cup instead of setting it down (0.75); dropping the cup into the tray (0.75 at most). Doing nothing scores 0.
